notes.subject: נהה נהי נהיה
notes.rationale: Tupela-tripela tok klostu wankain (kraikrai, krai, krai bilong pen) — persona bilong tok i kamap strong long Hibru, Tasol i no inap kamap fulap long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: שדוד / נשדנו
notes.rationale: Wanem as bilong שדד i kam tupela taim: 'ol i bagarapim, mipela i bagarap olgeta' — narapela tok i stat wantaim wankain bilong שדינו (gaden) long laspela tok.

notes.subject: לשובב
notes.rationale: 'Long man i hariap lus / man i go bek' — JPS ritim 'olsem narapela man i wokim gaden i go bek long mi', KJV ritim 'em i tanim asi na i makim'; tok i gat planti min.

notes.subject: tok stori bilong dai
notes.rationale: Tok stori (משל) bai singim long ol — em i tok hait we i save bipo long taim ol i bagarap.

translation: Long dispela de, ol bai singim wanpela tok stori long yupela, na ol bai kraikrai long wanpela krai bilong pen; ol bai tok: Ol i bagarapim mipela olgeta! Ol i senisim hap bilong ol man bilong mi; olsem wanem em i lus long mi! Long man i hariap lus, ol i makim ol gaden bilong mipela.
